_comment: The weekly scheduler takes the first item with status 'queued', writes the post, then marks it 'published'. Add topics here any time; if the queue empties, the scheduler proposes new topics from the existing catalogue instead of stopping.

defaults.audience: Salesforce admins, consultants and ISV founders
defaults.voice: Direct, practical, British spelling, no hype, no exclamation marks. Short sentences. Concrete examples from real org work.
mustInclude: One specific, checkable example or short walkthrough
A closing section that links to a relevant TwinStack product or service
No invented statistics, customer names or Salesforce release numbers
